2fas-android.description:
2FAS Authenticator is a free, open-source two-factor authentication app that helps protect online accounts with one-time verification codes. It supports standard TOTP and HOTP authentication, making it compatible with thousands of services, including Google, Microsoft, GitHub, and many other websites.

Add accounts by scanning a QR code or entering a setup key, then generate login codes even without an internet connection. Organize your accounts, customize their appearance, and use convenient home-screen widgets to access authentication codes.

Protect the app with a PIN or biometric authentication. Optional backups and Google Drive synchronization make it easier to restore your tokens if you change or lose your device. You can also import accounts from other authenticator apps, including Google Authenticator.

The companion 2FAS Browser Extension supports convenient browser logins without repeatedly typing authentication codes. The app does not require a 2FAS account and keeps authentication tokens under your control.

2FAS is developed by Two Factor Authentication Service, Inc. and released under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Its application graphics have separate licensing terms.
